convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <file.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>", ...], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import and font URL resolve. Re-export verified byte-identical across consecutive runs (all 7 frames).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; contract pixelThreshold 0.03 is the looser Gate-1 story budget); targets = NORMALIZED prototype, per-state contract roots ('#cs-buttons .ui-spec > div:has(> #uiTabsDemo)' for tabs, '#uiAccDemo' for accordion), Chromium 151 (playwright 1.58), viewport 900x700, deviceScaleFactor 2, CAPTURE v2.1 discipline (freeze CSS, fonts ready, pointer parking, geometry quiescence, self-consistency gate). CRITICAL CAPTURE FACT: targets rendered with --disable-lcd-text --font-render-hinting=none — Linux Chromium defaults to LCD subpixel AA, which poisons the compare against pen's grayscale rasterizer with color-fringed glyph edges (measured 1.5-3.8% false diff); grayscale-unhinted matches both the pen renderer and the pinned macOS GC lab. Heebo served to the render from the same TTF the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf).
convergence.iterationNotes: It 1: initial authoring from measured geometry, per-line text nodes (1.5-3.8%). It 2: per-word text runs — pen and Chromium glyph advances drift cumulatively on 13px text (~3% of line width); word-anchored positioning resets the drift per word (1.1-2.8%). [Infra correction, not counted: targets re-rendered grayscale-unhinted — see comparison — dropped diffs to 0-1.26%.] It 3: focused accordion head radius-snap — with :focus-visible's border-radius, Chromium's rounded-border paint path snaps the fractional (40.5px) border-box bottom UP to the device grid; hairline+ring painted +0.5px lower (1.26->0.674%). It 4: 13px body text +1px Y compensation (alignment probe showed export ink 1 device px high; 0.90->0.22%, 0.81->0.56%). It 5: snap modeled as bottom-edge STRETCH, not rigid shift — the ring's top edge does not move (0.674->0.062%). Text at 15px/14px needed zero compensation: pen 0.3.5 and grayscale Chromium 151 rasterize Heebo identically to byte level on the two all-integer-geometry tabs states (0.000%).
convergence.geometryProbesDetail: Probes derived from design-rules 2/3/8/10/11/12 against the measured normalized-prototype boxes and asserted on the exports: strip hairline 1px full-width under the trigger row; selected-trigger 2px accent underline overlaying the hairline (margin-bottom -1px) with transparent 2px reserve on unselected triggers; focus-ring 3px segments (right+bottom, sem-borders-focus) with the 4px-radius annulus; head/body 1px hairlines (open row reads title/hairline/body/hairline); chevron 16x16 orientation via ink-spread analysis (apex-down collapsed, apex-up expanded, stroke ~#767169). G-vectors carried by frame dims: tabs 420x89 default/focus, 276x68 second-selected (content-hugging, rule 5); accordion 340x81/141/182.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: shared :focus-visible ring wash (tabs triggers + disclosure heads, box-shadow 0 0 0 3px)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Hemlock's a11y contract names sem-borders-focus as THE focus ring (>=3:1 contrast required; Bill's pale wash measures ~1.1:1 on the taupe band). Role-first binding turns the ring near-black (#0E0E0E) in light — deliberate divergence from the prototype's literal wash, same ruling GC-001 recorded. Note sem-background-highlight matches Bill's pair exactly (#EBF0FE/#16304A) but is a background role, not the focus role.

The contract roots have no background of their own; the captured backdrop is the demo tile's taupe band, whose role is the page canvas (sem-background-main light = taupe-100). Demo scaffolding bound to the canvas role, not a component surface.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: pane copy (14px) + disclosure body copy (13px) line-height 1.5
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The 1.5 ratio exists in the scale as the base-step ratio; bound it rather than minting a duplicate. CROSS-PAIRED: the scale pairs sm(14) with 1.4286 — the off-step pairing is recorded as a designGap for the designer's adopt-vs-remap ruling.

tokenJudgmentCalls.boundToken: (none — frames drawn from measured prototype geometry)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: hemlock-library has TabsGroup/TabItem and Accordion components, but they are a different design (their own chrome, states, and metrics) that cannot reproduce this executable spec's geometry (underline-overlays-hairline idiom, content-hugging panes, double-hairline open rows). Under the two-oracle split the .pen is the pixel oracle OF THIS prototype; composing the library components would fail every pixel compare. Divergence from the existing Hemlock Tabs/Accordion is a designer-visible fact, not silently resolved here.

No Hemlock icon role carries this value: sem-icons-subtle (#8A8680) is exactly the handoff value Bill deliberately darkened for WCAG AA (prototype line 455 comment) — binding it would undo an accessibility decision; sem-icons-meta (#5E5954) overshoots. Created the role with Bill's own light/dark pair. Full reconciliation data in designGaps.
